# What I work on

I'm a chemical engineering student at the University of Delaware who builds tools and studies materials at the intersection of polymer science, data analysis, and scientific computing. I'm also an R&D co-op at DuPont Water Solutions, where I work on ion-exchange resin synthesis and applications, and a member of the Jayaraman Lab, where I calculate thermal properties of block-copolymer structures with LAMMPS.

::: {.home-intro}
My work usually starts with a messy experimental or research question and ends with a clearer model, a useful tool, or a result someone else can inspect and reuse.
:::

### [PFD TikZ Studio](projects/pfd%20maker%20v2/index.html)

A browser-based editor for drawing chemical engineering process-flow diagrams and exporting editable TikZ code.

[Open the app](https://kylecapybara.github.io/pfd-tikz-studio/) · [View source](https://github.com/kylecapybara/pfd-tikz-studio)

### [Equilibrium Pressure Extractor](projects/pressure%20tool/index.html)

A client-side tool for turning vapor-liquid equilibrium pressure signals into marked regions, statistics, and exportable results.

[Open the tool](https://kylecapybara.github.io/pressure-tool/equilibrium_pressures.html) · [View source](https://github.com/kylecapybara/pressure-tool)
:::
